children: The following are significant news stories, press reports and events on Friday. ALL TIMES GMT (Poland: GMT + 2 hours):
Saudi Arabia is offering European customers more crude oil for the remainder of October and November, and Poland's Orlen
is expected to get at least four October-loading Saudi cargoes, shipping data showed and sources said, adding to signs of a recovery in supplies.

The Polish Bank Association, which represents most of the country’s lenders, is in talks with public institutions to share the risk of financing defence projects, its vice president Agnieszka Wachnicka said on Thursday.

Energy Minister Milosz Motyka said that he does not rule out the possibility of extending the fuel price cap program into next year, noting that such a decision would depend on the situation in the fuel market, television TVN24 reported.
